name: Salvage Refactor Task
description: Gut messy legacy code while preserving a frozen surface with hard dependency, dead-code, duplication, and parity gates.

deterministic_checks.name: preserve-parity
deterministic_checks.command: python maw-tools/salvage_check.py preserve-parity --characterization-baseline artifacts/characterization-baseline.json --target <path> --preserved-surface artifacts/preserved-surface.json --run <run_dir> --output artifacts/preserve-parity.json

deterministic_checks.name: hidden-deps
deterministic_checks.command: python maw-tools/salvage_check.py hidden-deps --graph artifacts/code-graph.json --root <path> --coverage artifacts/hidden-deps-tests.json --output artifacts/hidden-deps.json

deterministic_checks.name: cross-lang
deterministic_checks.command: python maw-tools/salvage_check.py cross-lang --graph artifacts/code-graph.json --root <path> --coverage artifacts/hidden-deps-tests.json --output artifacts/cross-lang-couplings.json

deterministic_checks.name: dead-code
deterministic_checks.command: python maw-tools/salvage_check.py dead-code --graph artifacts/code-graph.json --preserved-surface artifacts/preserved-surface.json --removed artifacts/removed-symbols.json --output artifacts/dead-code.json

deterministic_checks.name: duplication
deterministic_checks.command: python maw-tools/salvage_check.py duplication --graph artifacts/code-graph.json --plan artifacts/duplication-plan.json --output artifacts/duplication.json

deterministic_checks.name: salvage-resistance
deterministic_checks.command: python maw-tools/salvage_check.py resistance --graph artifacts/code-graph.json --preserved-surface artifacts/preserved-surface.json --removed artifacts/removed-symbols.json --duplication-plan artifacts/duplication-plan.json --coverage artifacts/hidden-deps-tests.json --baseline artifacts/characterization-baseline.json --root <path> --output artifacts/salvage-resistance.json
